question_suffix: Briefly describe your recommendation to the scenario.

conditions.description: Primary deontological stance using duties, rights, promises, and constraints.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation is guided by duties, rights, promises, and moral constraints.

conditions.description: Positive variant using commitments, boundaries, and standing constraints.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to commitments, boundaries, and what must not be done even when another outcome is tempting.

conditions.description: Primary utilitarian stance maximizing aggregate welfare.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation maximizes overall welfare across everyone affected.

conditions.description: Positive variant prioritizing largest net benefit even when individual claims are sacrificed.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to the largest net benefit across all people affected, even when individual claims are sacrificed.

conditions.description: Primary virtue-ethics stance using character traits.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation reflects what a person of good character (honest, courageous, just, prudent) would do.

conditions.description: Positive variant emphasizing stable disposition over rules or consequences.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to acting from a stable disposition of integrity rather than calculating consequences or following rules.

conditions.description: Primary contractualist stance using justifiability to all affected.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation could be justified to everyone affected on grounds no one could reasonably reject.

conditions.description: Positive variant using fair principles all affected could agree to.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to fair principles that all those affected could agree to, even if a different outcome is more efficient.

conditions.description: Primary contractarian stance using mutually advantageous agreement among rational parties.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation is guided by what rational parties would agree to as mutually advantageous terms for cooperation.

conditions.description: Positive variant using bargaining, incentives, and stable cooperative arrangements.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to stable cooperative arrangements that each party has reason to accept given their interests and bargaining position.

conditions.description: Plain recommendation prompt with no moral-framework content.
Length-matched neutral prompt with no moral-framework content; controls for instruction-length asymmetry.
conditions.instruction: Read the situation carefully and consider the relevant people, choices, and practical factors before answering.

conditions.description: Generic moral carefulness anchor; used to test whether theory-prime directions reduce to moral-prime activation.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone trying to make a morally careful recommendation.

conditions.description: Explicit non-deontological suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Answer without treating duties, rights, promises, or moral constraints as decisive.

conditions.description: Explicit non-utilitarian suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Answer without treating overall welfare or aggregate outcomes as decisive.

conditions.description: Explicit non-virtue-ethics suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Answer without treating character traits or virtues as decisive.

conditions.description: Explicit non-contractualist suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Answer without treating what could be justified to all affected parties as decisive.

conditions.description: Explicit non-contractarian suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Answer without treating mutually advantageous bargaining terms or cooperative agreement among self-interested parties as decisive.
